blocks.en: B.3 Value-Neutral SFT Training
blocks.zh: B.3. 价值 -- -- Neutral SFT 培训

blocks.en: In order to provide a better initialization for our DPO training, we would like to train directly on top of a model that has already been initialized with SFT, rather than directly applying DPO to a base model. However, not all open-weights models have publicly accessible SFT checkpoints, and existing SFT training may substantially shift the expressed values of a model. To solve this, we decided to train our own value-neutral SFT checkpoints for each of our base models. We sampled 50,000 50,000 data points from the publicly available Tulu 3 SFT mix 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/tulu-3-sft-olmo-2-mixture , which was used to train open-weights models such as Olmo. We then applied a similar value-relevance labelling to each data point as in Section B.2 , using Qwen-3.6-27B as an automated judge; the exact prompt used is provided below. We then filtered out any data points in the SFT mix that were judged as being relevant to at least one of the 66 66 values in the Constitution value set. We then subsampled 19,748 19,748 SFT examples from the remaining value-neutral subset, using stratified sampling to remain as close to the original Tulu 3 data distribution as possible. Table 5 shows the final breakdown by source of our value-neutral SFT data. We then fine-tuned our base models on this data mixture using the same SFT recipe as described in Section B.1 .

blocks.en: In this section, we include additional information about how we used the existing value alignment evaluation pipeline ConflictScope ( Liu et al., 2026 ) to evaluate the steering effects of our fine-tuning interventions. We largely used the ConflictScope pipeline as is, with a few small changes. First, we used the open-weights model Qwen-3.6-27B for value conflict scenario generation, filtering, and judging (in the interactive evaluation setting). Before settling on this model, we ran a direct comparison between Qwen-3.6-27B, the models used for generation in the original ConflictScope paper (Claude-3.5-sonnet and GPT-4.1), and a few recent open- and closed-weights models, including GPT-5, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.5 ( Singh et al., 2025 ) , and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) . Specifically, we compute the original paper’s Observed Agreement Rate and Likert Difference Rate metrics over 320 unfiltered examples from the paper’s Personal-Protective dataset. Figure 5 shows that Qwen-3.6-27B is a Pareto improvement over both of the models used in the original paper (improving observed agreement while keeping Likert Difference Rate constant within error), and on the Pareto frontier of all models considered.

blocks.en: Finally, we observed that when running interactive evaluation on ConflictScope scenarios, the evaluation model frequently wrote user prompts with references to missing artifacts, such as student essays relevant to the value conflict scenario. We found that this was due to refusals when the evaluation model called another model to write the artifact text. We identified 1,240 1,240 contaminated user prompts, and resampled user prompts from the same context three times for each case. This allowed us to patch 952 952 of the corrupted scenarios, while the remaining scenarios were dropped from the final evaluation set. We used gemini-3.7-flash 5 5 5 https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-3-7-flash/ with the below prompt to detect corrupted user prompts.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Methodological Details on Value Embedding Computation
blocks.zh: 附录D 嵌入计算值的方法细节

blocks.en: In this section, we describe additional methodological details on how we computed candidate value representations in Section 4.1 , while highlighting all relevant divergences between our method and previous work that introduced the representations.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们描述了我们如何计算第4.1节中候选人价值表述的更多方法细节,同时强调了我们的方法与介绍这些表述的以往工作之间的所有相关差异。

blocks.en: We generate elicitation data following the general recipe in Chen et al. (2025) . For each value, we first generate value-specific metadata, including the values, pro-value system prompts, and anti-value system prompts. We used Gemini-3.7-flash to generate this, before manually auditing outputs. We then prompted each base model with each of the system prompts to generate up to 1000 1000 pro-value and anti-value responses, which were filtered for coherence and adherence to their system prompt by Gemini-3.5-flash-lite according to Chen et al. (2025) . We used a value-neutral version of the URIAL template to elicit responses from base models with limited instruction-following capabilities ( Lin et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们根据Chen等人(2025年)的一般食谱生成诱导数据。 对于每个值,我们首先生成特定值元数据,包括值,亲值系统提示和反值系统提示. 我们用双子座-3.7-闪电生成这个,在人工审核产出之前. 随后,我们促使每个系统的基本模型都催生出多达1000个亲值和反值反应,这些反应被双子座-3.5-flash-lite在Chen等人(2025年)的催化下过滤,以达到一致和坚持它们的系统。 我们使用URIAL模板的无价值版本,从指导跟踪能力有限的基本模型中获取回应(Lin等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: To select the specific model layer from which to compute Persona and Gradient representations for Olmo-3-7B and Qwen-3-8B models, we use persona vectors at each candidate layer to steer the model at α = 1.5 \alpha=1.5 . We use a held-out evaluation data split (generated in the same way as the original elicitation data) and judge the steered model’s spec adherence at each candidate layer. We specifically consider every other layer from layers 10-32 for Olmo, and every other layer from layers 10-36 for Qwen, respectively. We select the layer where steering yielded the highest spec adherence; this was Layer 18 for Qwen and Layer 16 for Olmo. For the Olmo-3.1-32B-SFT vectors computed in Section 6.2 and the Qwen-3-30B-A3B and Olmo-3-32B base models studied in Section 4.2 , we fixed Layer 32 (Olmo) and 24 (Qwen), as these represented the same relative depths as the best layers on the smaller-scale models in the same family. We used the same layers for Gradient as we did for Persona , as the former is not explicitly designed for use as a steering vector.
blocks.zh: 为了选择用于计算奥尔莫-3-7B和Quen-3-8B模型的Persona和Gradient表示的具体模型层,我们使用每个候选层的Persona向量来引导模型为α=1.5\α=1.5. 我们使用被搁置的评价数据分割(以与原始引出数据相同的方式生成),并判断被引导模型在每个候选层的光谱一致性。 我们特别考虑从10至32层到奥尔莫的所有其他层,从10至36层到奎恩的所有其他层。 我们选择方向盘产生最高光谱的层;这是18层对Quen,16层对Olmo。 对于第6.2节所计算的Olmo-31-32B-SFT向量以及第4.2节所研究的Quen-3-30B-A3B和Olmo-3-32B基本模型,我们固定了第32层(Olmo)和24层(Quen),因为这些相对深度与同一家族较小模型上的最佳地层相同。 我们用同样的地层 与我们用Persona, 因为前者没有明确设计 用作方向矢量。

blocks.en: We test the sensitivity of these methods to the choice of layer by computing the cosine similarity grids used to predict alignment generalization for each layer. Figure 6 shows the result of this analysis; we find that with the exception of the final layer in Qwen models, the Persona predictor grid is highly similar across layers, with a mean Spearman correlation above 0.9 0.9 . This suggests that within reasonable bounds, the results presented in Section 4.2 are not sensitive to the choice of layer.
blocks.zh: 我们通过计算用于预测每层对齐通化的同位素相似度网格来测试这些方法对地层选择的敏感性. 图6显示了这一分析的结果;我们发现,除了Quen模型中的最后一层外,Persona预测器网格在各层高度相近,平均Spearman相关度高于0.9.9. 这表明,在合理的限度内,第4.2节所述结果对选择层不敏感。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Persona vector sensitivity to layer choice: we compute Persona embeddings across many candidate layers, then study the correlation between each layer’s cosine similarity grid and the grid at our selected layer. Relative depth is the layer number normalized by the total number of layers, which differs across models. Predictor similarity grids are highly correlated across layers.
blocks.zh: 图6: Persona 矢量对地层选择的敏感性:我们计算 Persona 嵌入到许多候选地层,然后研究每个地层的同位素相似度网格与我们所选地层的网格之间的关联性. 相对深度是图层数由图层总数正常化而成,这些图层数因模型而异. 博士前相似性网格层层间高度相通.

blocks.en: In this section, we present additional results from the single-value generalization matrix experiments described in Section 3 . Figures 8 , 9 , 10 and 11 show heatmaps representing the full generalization matrices computed for our Olmo DPO, Qwen DPO, Olmo SFT, and Qwen SFT experiments, respectively, at 7-8B scale. Similarly, Figures 12 , 13 , 14 and 15 show the same experimental outputs for our 30B-scale experiments. As shown in Table 7 , we find that values transfer to other values in similar ways across different base models and fine-tuning methods.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows the average steering effect of single-value training across interventions, both on diagonal (training and evaluating on the same value) and off-diagonal (evaluating on different values). We find that our single-value interventions are generally effective at steering base models toward their targeted value, with average steerability values ranging from 26 % 26\% to 42 % 42\% across interventions. Additionally, we find that the interventions are also generally targeted, as the average off-diagonal generalization cell had a lower magnitude than the average diagonal cell across models and training methods. This validates our choice of single-value training pipeline, and shows that our generalization matrices are well-formed and reasonable objects of study.

blocks.en: Appendix F Additional Elicitation Data Results
blocks.zh: 附录F 附加说明数据结果

blocks.en: In this section, we present the results of two additional alignment generalization prediction experiments, which aimed to show whether computing representations on different elicitation data would improve correlation with the ground-truth generalization matrices. For both experiments, we focus on the highest-performing Persona and Gradient methods, and only compute predictors over the smaller 7-8B models.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了另外两项对齐通化预测实验的结果,这些实验旨在显示不同诱导数据的计算表示是否将改善与地-真实通化矩阵的相关性。 对于这两个实验,我们专注于性能最高的Persona和Gradient方法,并且仅对较小的7-8B模型进行计算预测.

blocks.en: Fig. 16 compares representations computed with the URIAL-templated base model used in section 4.1 , with representations computed with the value-neutral SFT model defined in section 3 . We hypothesized that using a similar model with stronger instruction-following capabilities to generate elicitation data might lead to more accurate prediction of alignment generalization dynamics on our SFT interventions. However, we found that on average, using a pretrained base model to generate elicitation data and as a source of activations outperformed the neutral-SFT variant, as well as a hybrid variant with base model activations on SFT-generated elicitation data. This shows the importance of collecting on-policy activations when computing representations.
blocks.zh: 图16比较了第4.1节中使用的URIAL延时基准模型和以第3节所定义的无价值SFT模型计算的表示值。 我们假设,使用一个具有更强指导跟踪能力的类似模型来生成引出数据,可能导致更准确地预测我们SFT干预措施的相通性动态。 然而,我们发现,平均而言,使用预先训练过的基模型生成诱导数据,作为活化源,其活化性超过了中-SFT变体,以及在SFT生成的诱导数据上具有活化基模型的混合变体. 这表明在计算表述时收集政策激活的重要性。

blocks.en: Fig. 17 compares representations computed with our generic trait elicitation data (following Chen et al. (2025) ) with representations computed with the actual DPO training pairs, which served as an oracle setting for the Persona and Gradient methods. Because we only had DPO data for 49 49 of the traits, we directly compared generalization prediction over 49 × 49 49\times 49 submatrices of the DPO generalization matrices. We found only a modest (and not significant) increase when using DPO training pairs for Persona , and a significant decrease when using DPO training pairs for Gradient . This suggests that generic trait elicitation data is already capable of performing well on the alignment generalization prediction task even without access to ground-truth alignment training data. We hypothesize that generic elicitation data has higher contrast between value-aligned and value-opposed responses, which may provide a clearer signal for predicting downstream generalization effects.

blocks.en: Appendix G Additional Prefill Robustness Results
blocks.zh: 附 录 G 预填坚固度结果

blocks.en: In this section, we discuss our choice of metric for the prefill robustness experiments described in Section 5 , and show that our multi-value training results are consistent across different candidate robustness metrics. We compare to two recent papers that also use prefill robustness to determine how deeply a model’s trained behavior is ingrained in the model. Maiya et al. (2025) use prefill adherence, which is the rate at which the model expresses a character trait after a character-neutral prefill. We adapt this to our adversarial setting by simply using the rate at which the model adheres to its alignment target. However, this may disproportionately favor models that consistently adhere to the alignment target, even if they are not particularly robust. In comparison, Sturgeon et al. (2026) compare defend rate , whether the model stands by a prefilled statement, in settings where the statement is aligned or misaligned with a target persona. We adapt this to our adversarial setting by taking the difference of prefill adherence between the pro-target and anti-target settings. Similarly, we view our normalized metric as the version that best controls for baseline adherence in this specific setting. In all cases, we use the ConflictScope evaluations to measure raw adherence.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们讨论我们为第5节所描述的预填稳健性试验选择的衡量标准,并表明我们的多值培训结果在不同候选稳健性衡量标准之间是一致的。 我们比较了最近两篇论文, Maiya等 (2025) 使用预填的坚持性,即模型在字符中性预填后表达字符特征的速度. 我们通过使用模型遵守校正目标的速度来适应我们的对抗环境。 然而,这可能不成比例地倾向于一贯遵守调整目标的模式,即使这些模式并非特别有力。 相较之下,Sturgeon等人(2026年)比较了在语句与目标人物对齐或错配的设置中,该模型是否以预先填充的语句为站点的防御速率. 我们把它适应于我们的对抗环境,把支持目标与反对目标之间的预填坚持度区别。 同样,我们认为,我们的规范度量标准是在这个具体环境下对基线遵守情况进行最佳控制的一种版本。 在所有情况下,我们使用冲突范围评价来衡量原始遵守情况。

blocks.en: Appendix I Comparing ValueMap to Other Taxonomies
blocks.zh: 附录一 将价值图与其他分类比较

blocks.en: In this section, we conduct additional analyses of ValueMap , the value taxonomy defined in Section 6.2 . Specifically, we compare how different models represent the space of values in VITW , as well as how our value categories compare to those found in existing taxonomies.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们对第6.2节所定义的价值分类法“价值图”进行了更多的分析。 具体地说,我们比较了不同模型如何代表VITW中的值空间,以及我们的价值类别如何与现有分类中发现的值进行比较.

blocks.en: We use the Mantel test ( Mantel, 1967 ) to compare the 266 × 266 266\times 266 persona similarity matrices computed with both the Olmo-3.1-32B-SFT used to taxonomize values in Section 6.2 and a value-neutral finetune of Qwen-3-8B base. We compute a Mantel ρ \rho of 0.82 0.82 , suggesting strong shared internal structure between the two similarity matrices. This can also be observed when directly plotting Procrustes-aligned ( Gower, 1975 ) versions of the similarity matrices. Fig. 19 shows a comparison of persona vector representational geometry on the VITW value set between the two models. This qualitatively demonstrates the similar internal structure of Persona -computed representations between the two models.
blocks.zh: 我们使用曼特尔测试(Mantel,1967年)来比较266×266\times 266人a的相似性矩阵,与用于将第6.2节中的值分类的Olmo-3.1-32B-SFT和Quen-3-8B基值中性的微调相比较。 我们计算出一个Mantel $\rho 0.82 0.82,建议两个相似性矩阵之间有强大的共享内部结构. 在直接绘制类似矩阵的Procrustes-access(Gower,1975年)版本时也可以观察到这一点. 图19显示在两个模型之间的VITW值集上比较了人a矢量代表几何. 这从质量上证明了Persona的类似内部结构----两个模型之间的计算表述。

blocks.en: Figure 19: A comparison of persona vector geometry on the VITW value set, for Olmo-3.1-32B-SFT, as well as Qwen-3-8B. Persona vector geometry is highly similar between the two models, with a Mantel ρ \rho of 0.82 0.82 , suggesting that ValueMap is relatively robust to choice of base model.

blocks.en: We also directly compare the value categories defined by ValueMap -Olmo-32B, ValueMap -Qwen-8B, and the original Values in the Wild paper. Figure 20 compares cluster assignments between ValueMap -Olmo-32B and each of the two other candidate taxonomies. We find that the core members of each category are similar between the two ValueMap variants, and that some categories (such as rigor ) are preserved between models. However, there also exist some ValueMap -Qwen-8B categories that end up split between different ValueMap -Olmo-32B categories.
blocks.zh: 我们还直接比较了由ValueMap - Olmo-32B,ValueMap - Quen-8B定义的数值类别,以及"荒地"纸中原有的数值. 图20比较了ValueMap-Olmo-32B与其他两个候选分类体系中的每一个组合分配. 我们发现,每个类别的核心成员在两种价值地图变体之间是相似的,有些类别(如刚性)在模型之间保存. 然而,也存在一些"价值地图"-"Qwen-8B"类,最终被分出不同的"价值地图"-"Olmo-32B"类.

blocks.en: Similarly, there exist shared subcategories between ValueMap -Olmo-32B and VITW, such as rigor being a combination of practical and epistemic values, or integrity being largely protective values, with some social values. However, there also exist many differences between the two taxonomies. We quantitatively validate this observation by computing adjusted Rand index ( Hubert and Arabie, 1985 ) , a measure of how similar two partitions of a dataset are, between both pairs of taxonomies. We compute a metric value of 0.24 0.24 between the two ValueMap variants and a metric value of 0.10 0.10 between ValueMap -Olmo-32B and VITW. While both values represent moderately above-chance similarity, the two ValueMap variants are both qualitatively and quantitatively closer in nature.
blocks.zh: 同样,在ValueMap - Olmo-32B和VITW之间也存在共同的子类,例如刚性是实用和认知价值的结合,或完整性基本上是保护价值,有些社会价值. 然而,两个分类法之间也存在许多差异. 我们通过计算调整后的Rand指数(Hubert and Arabie, 1985年)从数量上验证了这一观测结果,这是对数据集的相近的两个分区的衡量,介于两种分类法之间。 我们计算两个价值图变体之间的公尺值为0.24 0.24,而价值图-Olmo-32B和VITW之间的公尺值为0.10 0.10。 虽然这两个数值在性质上和数量上都略为相近,但两个价值图变量在质量和数量上都更为接近。

blocks.en: Figure 20: A comparison of cluster assignments for each of the 266 266 VITW values, between two variants of ValueMap computed on different models, as well as between ValueMap (Olmo 32B) and the original Values in the Wild categories. We find moderate similarity between ValueMap variants between different models, and lower similarity between ValueMap and Values in the Wild.
